landing.heroTitle: Earn money by registering Kosovo's businesses
landing.heroText: KS Data is the portal for runners: register local businesses with photos, address and contact details — you earn €0.50 for every approved entry.
landing.how1Text: Create a free account with your email.
landing.how2Text: Name, category, city, contact and photos — straight from your phone.
landing.how3Text: Once approved, the amount is credited to your account and paid out by bank transfer.
